title: What do you do on Saturdays?
subtitle: Free time and hobbies — like, love, hate + -ing
canDo: I can talk about my free time and hobbies.
I can use like, love, don't like and hate + -ing.
I can ask: What do you do in your free time?
teacherNotes: Warm-up: Öğrencilerden en sevdikleri hafta sonu aktivitesini tek kelimeyle söylemelerini isteyin, ekrana listeleyin.
like + -ing: "I like read" hatası çok yaygın. Kural: like / love / hate + fiil-ing (I like reading).
Yazım: swim → swimming, run → running (son harf ikizlenir); dance → dancing (e düşer). Tabloya bakarak çalıştırın.
Anket oyunu: Her öğrenci 3 arkadaşına "Do you like cooking?" gibi sorular sorar ve sonucu raporlar ("Omar likes cooking").

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Rose's Saturdays
sections.intro: Rose writes about her free time.
paragraphs: I'm sixty-eight, and I have a lot of free time now!
I love reading. I read two or three books every week.
I enjoy working in my garden, and I like taking photos of my flowers.
I don't like watching TV. Tom loves it, but I don't!
On Saturday evenings, I play cards with my friend Dorothy.
We talk, we laugh and we eat a lot of cookies.
I hate cooking, but I love eating. Thank you, Omar, for the maqluba!

items.prompt: How many books does Rose read every week?

sections.title: Grammar: like / love / hate + -ing
rules: **love / like / enjoy / don't like / hate** + verb**-ing**: I like read**ing**.
Spelling: read → read**ing** · dance → danc**ing** (no e) · swim → swi**mm**ing, run → ru**nn**ing
Question: **Do you like** cook**ing**? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
he / she: She **likes** swimm**ing**. He **doesn't like** runn**ing**.

support.tr: like, love, enjoy, hate gibi fiillerden sonra ikinci fiil -ing alır: I like reading = Okumayı severim. Türkçedeki "-mayı / -meyi" ekine benzer. "I like read" yanlıştır. Yazıma dikkat: swim → swimming, dance → dancing.
support.ar: بعد الأفعال like و love و enjoy و hate نضيف ing إلى الفعل الثاني: I like reading = أحبّ القراءة. هذا يشبه المصدر في العربية (القراءة، الطبخ). لا نقول «I like read». وانتبه للإملاء: swim → swimming، dance → dancing.

tr.note: like / love / hate'ten sonra fiile -ing ekle.

ar.note: لا تضع to أو الفعل المجرّد بعد enjoy، واستخدم ing.
